managed_allocations.proof: Static source review: Burst jobs accept NativeArray fields only; no List, LINQ, Instantiate, or GlobalRegistry polling in Shinobu socket jobs. PlayerBuilder caches DataVault and ConstructionManager before active snap calls.

aup_precision.proof: EvaluateSocketSnappingJob uses double3 target-minus-ghost AUP deltas and writes an aligned float4x4; PlayerBuilder writes the snapped root AUP back into GhostPreviewDTO for instant truth plus Dear Lie shader presentation.

csr.proof: Target sockets are bucketed into six direction ranges after excluding Connected, CollisionBlocked, non-finite rows, and invalid direction masks. PackAllowedConnectionBitmask emits no direction bit for invalid authored input; ExtractDirection returns byte.MaxValue for zero or multi-bit masks; AreCompatible rejects invalid masks. Ghost rows preserve source SocketDefinitions indices, use inverse-direction CSR rows at 6 + ghostIndex, and resolve targets through SocketCsrTargetIndices. Invalid ghost rows are flagged NonFinite|CollisionBlocked with zero CSR range. Invalid CSR target rows consume budget, mark NonFinite, and continue within the bounded scan.

occupancy.proof: Target Vault rebuild transfers authored ModuleSocket.IsOccupied into SocketStateDTO.ConnectionStatus; active placement also marks the consumed ghost socket on the newly placed module; Burst evaluator rejects Connected rows before scoring. Hot Burst matching and cold authoring occupancy marking share AreCompatibilityHashesCompatible(), so wildcard/exact compatibility semantics do not diverge. HashCompatibility reserves 0 for wildcard by remapping non-empty folded zero to 1 before DTO packing.

scalability.proof: Candidate budget and search radius use smooth GlobalQualityWeight curves: 16 to 256 inspected CSR target rows per ghost, no low/high binary switch. Budget is consumed when a valid target row is read, before radius/compatibility/alignment rejection, so far bases cannot scan an entire inverse-direction bucket at low quality. Direction CSR removes incompatible and invalid-direction buckets before those quality budgets are consumed. SnapResults reserves 64 ghost rows plus one best-result sink row. Pending and cached poses require scene hash plus query hash over ghost root/yaw/blueprint/socket layout before reuse; the blueprint component uses ResolveShinobuModuleHash with TemplateHashId fallback. Cached Dear Lie pose state is invalidated on query mismatch and failed reducer results, so the shader fake cannot bridge across stale solver truth.

rollback.proof: All Shinobu socket jobs use Burst FloatMode.Deterministic and explicit-layout DTO arrays.

visual_fake.proof: DearLieHologram shader and the active BlueprintWireInstanced preview shader use scalar dampening and vertex sine wiggle; PlayerBuilder writes DearLieDampen, GlobalQualityWeight, and DearLieWiggleSpeed through ConstructionPreviewSignal padding at offsets 96/100/104, and HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch applies a quality-scaled decaying material envelope. Cold fallback proxy materials initialize _H8SnapDampen to 0 so the fake is event-driven. Connected/corridor/hatch state is flags in SocketStateDTO.ConnectionStatus, not instantiated door prefabs. GhostPreviewDTO DearLieActive is fed only from a current-query cached snap pose; stale pose state is cleared before new query truth is presented.

telemetry.proof: Active PlayerBuilder Vault snap path writes ConstructionSocketTelemetryEntry every solver call and dumps Dump_SHINOBU_217.bin on non-finite state. ConstructionPreviewSignal.ModuleHash, construction validation payloads, acoustic source fallback, and FloraExclusionSignal.ModuleHash use the same ResolveShinobuModuleHash fallback as GhostPreviewDTO and the Burst job.
